rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Dense residential kerb with homes 7-12 m away along its whole length.
reasons: Dwellings within 12 m along whole kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the south kerb at 8-14 m, with flats opposite; no gap anywhere.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a two-way street; cars park on both sides, so room is available.
drivers.traffic: Moderate through traffic; street links to Moggill Road.
drivers.convention: Cars do park along the street, but No Stopping signs cover parts of this stretch.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs on this street
sun_shade: Mostly open; patchy street-tree shade on the south kerb.

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace south kerb, between the two house groups
